-77.09900,38.99500.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
-77.09900,38.99500.state: Bethesda — National Library of Medicine, 8600 Rockville Pike
-77.09900,38.99500.desc: The register that makes the clinical facet knowable. Essentially every interventional trial run in or submitted to the United States must be registered, with sponsor, phase, condition and sites. It exists because sponsors were found abandoning trials with unfavourable results unpublished, and Congress legislated. Every other facet on this map is argued about using figures the industry chose to release; this one is not, and the difference is a law.

12.57000,55.68000.name: European Sperm Bank
12.57000,55.68000.desc: A large Danish sperm bank shipping internationally, and one of a small number of suppliers serving much of Europe. Family limits are set per country and applied by the bank rather than by any regulator with sight of the whole picture, so a donor legal in one jurisdiction may already have exceeded another's limit. Consumer DNA testing has since made the resulting sibling networks discoverable by the people in them, which no arrangement anticipated.

-46.63330,-23.55050.name: Abitrigo
-46.63330,-23.55050.state: São Paulo — Associação Brasileira da Indústria do Trigo
-46.63330,-23.55050.desc: Brazil's flour milling association said its members would stop buying Argentine wheat altogether if Brazil approved engineered wheat imports, a position shared by the groups representing bakers and other wheat processors. Around 80 per cent of Brazil's wheat imports come from Argentina, so the threat was substantial. When the biosafety commission approved the flour anyway, the association asked the president's office to convene a national biosecurity committee to review the decision. This is the clearest example on the map of the veto that sits downstream of a regulator: an approval grants permission to sell and does not oblige anyone to buy, and a processing industry that refuses can hold a cleared product off the market more effectively than an objection filed during the comment window.
